questions.stem: A 61-year-old male with longstanding GERD and a history of Barrett’s esophagus undergoes surveillance endoscopy. No mucosal irregularities are seen, but four-quadrant biopsies are obtained of the 2.5 Barrett's segment. Dysplasia is noted on several of the histologic specimens. Which of the following is the next step in management?

options.label: A
options.text: He should continue to undergo surveillance endoscopy to see if this develops into carcinoma.

options.label: B
options.text: He should undergo radiofrequency ablation therapy.

options.label: D
options.text: He should undergo endoscopic mucosal resection
